title: Customer Success Platform Hokdo Raises Multi-¥10M Pre-A Led by SIG + Jingya
summary: On Jun 27, 2022, customer-success SaaS Hokdo (获客多) (founded 2021) closed a multi-¥10M Pre-A co-led by SIG China and Jingya Capital, with MiraclePlus following — 2nd round — for automation/ML and go-to-market. Health scoring, lifecycle automation, project mgmt, customer analytics
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 28, 2022

On Jun 27, 2022, customer-success SaaS Hokdo (获客多) (founded 2021) closed a multi-¥10M Pre-A co-led by SIG China and Jingya Capital, with MiraclePlus following — 2nd round — for automation/ML and go-to-market. Health scoring, lifecycle automation, project mgmt, customer analytics — cut churn, lift upsell. Dozens of SaaS/software and smart-manufacturing design partners; target hundreds post H2’22 GA. Controller Xu Ziqiang ~33%.

— END —
